title: Car stopping time
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the time for the car to decelerate from 18 m/s to 0 m/s with a = -2 m/s², yielding 9 s.

title: Maximum distance calculation
description: Essential: Correctly identifies and calculates the maximum separation distance, which is 36 m.

title: Time to next meeting
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the total time from the initial meeting until the next meeting, yielding 13.5 s.

title: Equal speeds condition
description: Important: Recognizes that maximum separation occurs when the car's speed equals the bicycle's constant speed (6 m/s).

title: Displacement comparison
description: Important: Correctly calculates the displacements of both vehicles at the time of maximum separation and when the car stops.

title: Post-stop meeting analysis
description: Important: Correctly sets up the condition for the second meeting after the car has stopped, based on the remaining distance and the bicycle's speed.

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall: Uses acceleration as positive for braking/deceleration, leading to incorrect signs in kinematic equations.

title: Misidentifying maximum time
description: Pitfall: Assumes maximum distance occurs when the car stops, rather than when the speeds are equal.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent SI units (m, s, m/s²) throughout all calculations.
